source_text: Videtur mihi unusquisque sermo Scripturae divinae similis esse seminum. Iactum in terram regeneratur et multiplicatur. Sermo hic, si peritum colonum inveniat, crescit in arborem sicut granum sinapis. Precibus adsit sermo Dei.
pass_a_gloss: Seems to-me each word of-Scripture divine similar to-be to-seeds. Thrown into earth is-regenerated and is-multiplied. Word this, if skilled farmer it-may-find, grows into tree as grain of-mustard. By-prayers let-be-present word of-God.
pass_b_english: Every word of divine Scripture seems to me like seed. Cast into the earth it is born again and multiplies. This word, if it finds a skilled farmer, grows into a tree — [[like a mustard seed >> Bible:Matthew 13:31-32]]. By your prayers may the word of God be present.
